summary: Complaints centre on sugarcane dues, land acquisition in Khekra, bus and health services, while farmers credit timely cane payments, easier fertiliser supply and better irrigation power.

positives.english: Sugarcane payments now reach farmers on time
positives.hindi: गन्ने का भुगतान अब समय पर मिल रहा है
positives.basis: Aaj Tak ground report (26 Sep 2026) with Baghpat farmers: earlier there was trouble with cane purchase and payment, now payments are timely. District-level; the article names no AC place.

positives.english: Three Baghpat sugar mills have paid farmers in full
positives.hindi: बागपत की तीन चीनी मिलों ने किसानों का पूरा भुगतान किया
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026) states 'बागपत की तीनों चीनी मिलों ने किसानों का संपूर्ण भुगतान कर दिया है'; the three mills named are Malakpur, Baghpat and Ramala. District-level; AC membership of the mills not confirmed.

positives.english: Fertiliser no longer means long queues like before
positives.hindi: खाद के लिए अब पहले जैसी लंबी लाइन नहीं लगानी पड़ती
positives.basis: Aaj Tak (26 Sep 2026): 'अब खाद के लिए पहले जैसी लंबी कतारों का सामना नहीं करना पड़ता'. District-level; article names only Baghpat.

positives.english: Power availability for irrigation has improved
positives.hindi: सिंचाई के लिए बिजली की उपलब्धता में सुधार हुआ है
positives.basis: Aaj Tak (26 Sep 2026): 'सिंचाई के लिए बिजली की उपलब्धता में भी सुधार महसूस होता है'. Farmers' view as reported by the reporter; no figures given. District-level.

positives.english: Farmers no longer feel the same fear of going to fields at night
positives.hindi: रात में खेत पर जाने का पहले जैसा डर नहीं रहा
positives.basis: Aaj Tak (26 Sep 2026): 'पहले रात के वक्त खेत पर जाने में डर महसूस होता था', presented as improved under the current government. District-level.

negatives.english: Sugar mills still owe farmers ₹29 crore in cane dues
negatives.hindi: मिलों पर अभी भी गन्ने का 29 करोड़ रुपये बकाया है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026): Kinauni mill owes ₹20 crore and Bhainsana mill ₹9 crore; notices issued with one week to pay and a warning of action. District-level. Kinauni and Bhainsana are not confirmed inside this AC.

negatives.english: Land acquisition for an industrial area in 12 Khekra villages, farmers want 4x compensation
negatives.hindi: खेकड़ा में 12 गांवों की जमीन का अधिग्रहण, चार गुना मुआवजा चाहिए
negatives.basis: Univarta/Varta (25 Aug 2026): land acquisition for a proposed industrial area in 12 villages of the Khekra area; farmers insist on four times market rate; meeting chaired by SDM ended without agreement. Khekra tehsil is in the AC per Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: 23 doctors missing in Baghpat district, CHCs including Khekra and Baghpat short-staffed
negatives.hindi: बागपत में 23 डॉक्टर लापता, सीएचसी पर इलाज की दिक्कत
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (15 Sep 2026): 23 doctors missing and a shortage of 47 doctors in the district; CHCs named include Khekra and Baghpat. Article says people are not getting health services. District-level, with the named CHCs inside the AC.

negatives.english: Hours-long waits at Baghpat bus stand on Raksha Bandhan, passengers forced to hang onto vehicles
negatives.hindi: बागपत बस अड्डे पर घंटों इंतजार, लोग लटककर सफर करने को मजबूर
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (29 Aug 2026): on Raksha Bandhan, buses ran out at Baghpat's Bawli Chungi bus stand, passengers waited hours and were forced onto daggamar vehicles; a passenger said 'इनमें भी जगह नहीं मिल रही है और लटककर सफर करना पड़ रहा है'. Tatiri (Agarwal Mandi) also named; both are in the AC per Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: 15-hour power cut stopped water supply, villagers crowd handpumps
negatives.hindi: 15 घंटे बिजली गुल, पानी के लिए हैंडपंपों पर भीड़
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (6 Sep 2026): power stopped for 15 hours in Pooranpur Nawada and Garhi Kalanjari, Ratol tehsil; water supply stopped and women crowded government handpumps; residents complained and protested. Ratol is not named in the AC extent, so AC membership is unconfirmed.

notes: AC identity: Wikipedia list shows No. 52 as 'Bagpat' in Baghpat district, unreserved; the AC article uses Baghpat and Bagpat interchangeably. Extent per AC article: Khekra tehsil plus parts of Baghpat tehsil (KC Pilana, Pali, Pawla Bagamabad, Tatiri, Baghpat MB, Aminagar Sarai NP, Agarwal Mandi NP); the AC's area was not verified against the official delimitation order. Positives 1, 3, 4, 5 come from one Aaj Tak ground report, which is district-level and paraphrases farmers without village names. Not found despite searches: AC-specific reports on Baghpat town roads, drains, garbage (Aminagar Sarai, Agarwal Mandi), stray cattle, or water supply; no source was used for these. Lahchaura and the Sarfabad/Garhi Kalanjari villages named in the June 2026 ETV Bharat piece are not confirmed inside this AC, and the Kinauni and Bhainsana mills are unconfirmed. Baraut depot tyre shortage (Amar Ujala, 29 Sep 2026) was excluded since Baraut is AC 51. Field check suggested: Khekra land acquisition status, Baghpat town bus and drain conditions, sugarcane dues at Kinauni and Bhainsana mills, and the Baghpat CHC doctor vacancies.
